description: Grungy, distorted 808s and synth basses that stay full: the Dirt section distorts the top while Sub Keep blends the clean sub back underneath. 94 presets in Travis Scott, Mike Dean, untiljapan, Ye, Yeezus, KING, moshc0re, SAFE and trip-hop styles, plus regular bouncy 808s.
highlights: 808 body with punch, warmth and knock, plus two unison synth oscillators
Moog-style ladder filter, glide, release dive, tempo-synced LFO
8 distortion types at 4x oversampling with Sub Keep for heavy-but-full low end
Chorus, delay and space on the top only, so the sub stays mono
POLY switch: play chords with any preset (it stays put when you change presets)
installTips: Notes play at real pitch: the classic 808 range is C2–C3 in FL's piano roll (or use the Octave knob).

items: SAFE: 6 new basses in the Toronto R&B / trap lane of SAFE: a dark underwater 808, a bouncy dancehall bass, the clipped trap 808 of Paid In Full, a Doc McKinney-style 80s synth bass, a soft night-drive reese and an afro log-drum bass
